overlap_frontmatter.name: valuing-information
overlap_frontmatter.description: Prices research, tests, surveys, dashboards and experiments before running them, by computing how much the result would raise expected utility - which is zero whenever no outcome would change the decision. Use when someone proposes an A/B t

overlap_frontmatter.name: foundations-decision-theory
overlap_frontmatter.description: Decision-theory primitives for uncertain choices, utility, Bayesian decisions, regret, value of information, MCDA, options, and bandits. Use when choosing under uncertainty.

overlap_frontmatter.name: expected-value
overlap_frontmatter.description: Use when choosing among actions under quantified uncertainty by enumerating outcomes, assigning probabilities, valuing each outcome in one shared unit, computing probability-weighted value, testing sensitivity, and checking downside constra

overlap_frontmatter.description: Write, compose, integrate, and improve programs that call Jev, TypeSafe's System One judgment model.

overlap_frontmatter.name: mle-workflow

overlap_frontmatter.name: llm-evaluation
overlap_frontmatter.description: Implement comprehensive evaluation strategies for LLM applications using automated metrics, human feedback, and benchmarking. Use when testing LLM performance, measuring AI application quality, or establishing evaluation frameworks.

overlap_frontmatter.name: creating-eval-harness-evaluations

overlap_frontmatter.name: Decision Matrix (MCDA)
